tagline: Connect your engineering sprint schedule with Google Calendar automatically
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Linear Integration: Cycle Dates as Events
metaDescription: Sync Linear cycle dates to Google Calendar and add issue due dates as reminders. GAIA preps sprint planning from Linear. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering teams plan in Linear but schedule in Google Calendar. Sprint start and end dates live in Linear but don't appear on the calendar. Important deadlines and cycle reviews don't show up where engineers check their daily schedule. GAIA connects the two so your engineering timeline is visible wherever you look.

Cycle dates appear on the calendar. Calendar events for sprint planning and retrospectives generate cycle items. The engineering schedule and the project board tell the same story without manual synchronization between them.

useCases.title: Linear cycle dates synced to Google Calendar
useCases.description: Sprint cycles appear as calendar events with start and end dates, giving engineers and engineering managers visibility into the sprint timeline alongside their other commitments.

useCases.title: Issue due dates as calendar reminders
useCases.description: High-priority issues with due dates create calendar reminders so engineers see approaching deadlines in their calendar rather than only in Linear.

useCases.title: Sprint planning meeting prep from Linear
useCases.description: Before sprint planning events, GAIA compiles the backlog items proposed for the sprint and sends a prep summary so the team arrives with full context.

useCases.title: Retrospective data before review meetings
useCases.description: Before retrospective events, GAIA pulls cycle metrics (completed issues, velocity, cycle time) and creates a meeting prep document so retrospectives are data-informed.

useCases.title: Engineering milestone calendar events
useCases.description: Project milestones generate Google Calendar events so product launches, feature freezes, and major deliverables are visible on the shared team calendar.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your calendar and your Linear workspace. Specify which teams and cycles should sync to which calendars.
Choose which cycle events create calendar events, which issue due dates generate reminders, and which calendar events should pull issue context for prep summaries.

howItWorks.step: Engineering schedule and board stay aligned
howItWorks.description: Cycle timelines appear on the calendar automatically. Calendar events have issue context attached. Both tools reflect the same engineering schedule.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create Linear cycles from calendar date ranges I define?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA to create a new cycle based on dates you've set in the calendar for a sprint, and it will configure the cycle with the correct start and end dates.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync cycles for all teams or specific ones?
faqs.answer: You configure which teams sync to which calendars. This is useful for separating engineering team calendars from product or design team cycles.

faqs.question: Can GAIA send calendar invites to the team for sprint events?
faqs.answer: Yes. When GAIA creates calendar events from cycles, you can configure it to add your team members as guests so the sprint events appear on everyone's calendar.
